title: Aggregate Functions
summary: Aggregates summarize: COUNT rows, SUM/AVG numbers, MIN/MAX extremes, GROUP_CONCAT strings. They collapse many rows into one result.
learningObjectives: Apply the concept in a small program
Predict program output by reading code

sections.content: Aggregates summarize: COUNT rows, SUM/AVG numbers, MIN/MAX extremes, GROUP_CONCAT strings. They collapse many rows into one result.
With GROUP BY they summarize per group: COUNT orders per customer. HAVING filters the groups (WHERE filters rows before grouping).
Key points: COUNT(*) counts rows, COUNT(col) skips NULLs, AVG returns decimal, and empty groups produce no rows.

sections.codeExample:
SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS n, AVG(score) AS avg_score
FROM players
GROUP BY city
HAVING COUNT(*) > 10;
